title: Sophie Cunningham Dances in Itty-Bitty Bikini Goes Viral - NewsBreak
text:
By Anwayamane ,
54 minutes ago Photo Credit: Justin Casterline | Getty Images Sophie Cunningham showcased remarkable strength and resilience as she showed off her dance moves in a tiny printed bikini and a knee brace for support. The 29-year-old American athlete shared a video of herself grooving to assure her fans and well-wishers that she is recovering well after her season-ending injury temporarily put a halt to her career.
Sophie Cunningham shares dancing video amid injury Sophie Cunningham proved she has the heart of a true athlete when she posted the video to reassure fans of her well-being. The Indiana Fever star appeared in a tiny printed bikini with her hair tied back in a long ponytail. She accessorized with a cross-pendant necklace, dainty bracelets on both wrists, and powder-blue painted nails.
Cunningham sang along to Reneé Rapp’s “I Think I Like You Better When You’re Gone” while showing off her dance moves despite wearing a knee brace. She shared the clip on X with the caption, “Think I like you better,” taken from the song’s lyrics. The athlete smiled cheerfully throughout, undeterred by the discomfort of her injury.
Fans praised her in the comments, leaving messages such as, “Flawless. Get better soon!”, “Please get better soon,” and “Can’t wait to see you back on the court.”
On August 17, Cunningham’s dream run with the Fever ended abruptly after she tore the MCL in her right knee during a game against the Connecticut Sun. The devastating injury required immediate medical attention and forced her to step away from the court at a crucial point in the season.
The professional basketball player is currently resting and recuperating, but she hasn’t let the setback dampen her spirits. Instead, she continues to share positive, uplifting updates about her recovery journey on social media, reassuring fans that she remains focused on healing and determined to return stronger than ever.
